_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. Two SEPARATE Azure AD app registrations — one per tenant. App-only (client-credentials) auth. See README for the exact API permissions + admin consent each app needs. Secrets here are live credentials: keep config.json out of git.

source._comment: Tenant you are migrating FROM. App needs Sites.Read.All + Files.Read.All (application, admin-consented).

certificate._comment: Optional: use a certificate instead of client_secret (recommended). Set client_secret to null if using this.

dest._comment: Tenant you are migrating TO (different domain). App needs Sites.ReadWrite.All + Files.ReadWrite.All (application, admin-consented).

options._libraries_comment: null = all document libraries; or a list of source library display names to include, e.g. ["Documents", "Policies"].
